typography.heading_treatment: Archivo at display scale (H1 64–80px, H2 40–52px, H3 28–34px) in Black and Bold weights, uppercase or sentence case depending on hierarchy level — H1 hero titles in tight negative tracking (−0.03em) to convey precision engineering; H2 section titles in semibold with moderate tracking (−0.01em); all headings rendered in Coldframe White or Neural Violet-to-Pulse Amethyst gradient on dark surfaces for maximum luminous impact.

typography.accent_treatment: IBM Plex Mono in uppercase at 11–13px with wide letter-spacing (0.12–0.18em) exclusively for eyebrow labels, stat badges, room spec metadata, pricing tier tags, journal article category chips, and form field micro-labels — rendered in Synapse Cyan on dark surfaces or Precision Mist on mid-depth panels, never exceeding 14px, functioning as the system's technical annotation layer.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Axiom Hotel homepage is a three-act storytelling scroll built on a nocturnal deep-space canvas, delivering an unmistakably AI Lab experience — intelligent, precise, and future-facing. The page reads as a single continuous narrative: an immersive hero that asserts brand dominance, a technical feature grid that decodes the hotel's core pillars, and a high-voltage CTA close that converts curiosity into action.

SURFACE AND COLOR LOGIC: The page never breaks to white or light backgrounds. Section 1 (Hero) sits on Axiom Void (#0A0C14) — the absolute dark anchor. Section 2 (Feature Grid) shifts to Circuit Slate (#1E2535) — a mid-depth surface that creates layered depth without disrupting the dark palette continuity. Section 3 (CTA) returns to Axiom Void for a bookend effect, but is saturated with a full-bleed Neural Violet (#7C3AED) panel that occupies the entire section background — this is the most chromatic moment on the page and signals urgency. Synapse Cyan (#00D4E8) is used as a structural accent throughout: node-graph decorative line-work, eyebrow underlines, and glowing card borders. Pulse Amethyst (#C084FC) appears exclusively in gradient typography moments on the hero headline. Signal Graphite (#2E3A50) defines all border strokes, card dividers, and technical diagram rules. Precision Mist (#8B9BB8) handles all metadata, captions, and subdued labels.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY: Archivo Black at 72px (tight −0.03em tracking) owns the hero headline — a display-scale typographic stunt. IBM Plex Mono in uppercase at 12px / 0.16em letter-spacing handles all eyebrow labels in Synapse Cyan. IBM Plex Sans at 18px / 1.65 line-height handles body and subheadlines in Coldframe White. Section 2 card titles use Archivo Bold at 28px. The CTA section headline uses Archivo Black at 52px in Coldframe White.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The page's defining visual move lives in Section 1 — the hero headline "Where Every Stay Is Engineered for Excellence" is rendered at maximum display scale (72–80px Archivo Black) with the word "Engineered" breaking into a Neural Violet → Pulse Amethyst horizontal gradient, while a full-bleed abstract neural node-graph pattern (fine white/cyan lines connecting floating data-point nodes) pulses behind the text as a layered background texture. The node graph is not tucked into a corner — it dominates the entire hero viewport, bleeding edge-to-edge behind the text stack, with nodes concentrated toward the upper-right quadrant and thinning toward the lower-left where the text block anchors. This move is inevitable for the AI Lab aesthetic: the node graph is its primary visual_cue, and placing it at full amplitude in the hero establishes the brand's technical intelligence before a single word is read.

DENSITY AND WHITESPACE RHYTHM: Section 1 is sparse and monumental — maximum vertical padding (160px top / 140px bottom), text anchored left at 55% column width, right half occupied by the node-graph field. Section 2 is denser — three cards in a horizontal grid with 40px gaps, moderate vertical padding (80px top/bottom), each card carrying a technical diagram icon and spec metadata. Section 3 is compact and centred — tight vertical padding (100px top/bottom), centred type stack, two CTAs side by side, and the Neural Violet full-bleed background doing all the heavy lifting.

LAYOUT FAMILY — STORYTELLING SCROLL: Each section functions as a distinct narrative beat. Section 1 = Brand declaration. Section 2 = Proof of promise. Section 3 = Invitation to act. Large narrative transitions between sections are marked by a 2px Signal Graphite horizontal rule with a small Synapse Cyan node-dot at its midpoint — a recurring structural device that echoes circuit-board precision and signals the scroll rhythm without using whitespace alone.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR: On mobile (< 768px), the hero text stack expands to full width with the node-graph pattern as a full-bleed background overlay at reduced opacity (0.4) so text remains legible. The feature grid collapses from 3 columns to a single stacked column with 32px gaps. The CTA section's two buttons stack vertically with 16px gap. All padding values halve on mobile. Archivo hero headline scales down to 48px on mobile, 60px on tablet.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
SECTION TYPE: Hero. INTENT: Establish brand identity with a bold, intelligent first impression that pulls the visitor into the Axiom world.

LAYOUT AND GRID: Full-viewport-height section (min-height 100vh) on an Axiom Void (#0A0C14) background. Use a 12-column grid. The text content block occupies columns 1–7 (left-aligned, with 80px left padding on desktop). Columns 8–12 are visually 'owned' by the neural node-graph background element — no text intrudes there. The node-graph pattern is a full-bleed layer behind everything, rendered as fine Signal Graphite (#2E3A50) and Synapse Cyan (#00D4E8) lines connecting abstract floating node-dots, with node density concentrated in the upper-right quadrant (columns 8–12, top 60% of viewport) and fading/thinning toward the lower-left where the text block sits. The pattern extends edge-to-edge of the viewport — it is not contained in a box. A subtle radial gradient vignette in Axiom Void overlays the left half of the node-graph at ~60% opacity to ensure text legibility without fully suppressing the pattern.

EYEBROW: IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 12px, letter-spacing 0.16em, color Synapse Cyan (#00D4E8). Text: 'WELCOME TO AXIOM HOTEL'. Positioned above the headline with 0 0 12px 0 margin. A 24px-wide, 2px-tall Synapse Cyan underline rule sits beneath the eyebrow text, left-aligned to the text start — not full-width, just a short technical annotation mark.

HEADLINE: Archivo Black, 76px, tracking −0.03em, line-height 1.05. Text: 'Where Every Stay Is Engineered for Excellence'. Rendered across two or three lines depending on natural wrapping. The word 'Engineered' is styled with a left-to-right horizontal gradient from Neural Violet (#7C3AED) to Pulse Amethyst (#C084FC) — this is the SIGNATURE MOMENT of the entire page. All other words in the headline are Coldframe White (#EDF1F7). The gradient word should be on its own visual line if possible (natural line break encouraged by the column width constraint).

SUBHEADLINE: IBM Plex Sans, 18px, weight 400, line-height 1.65, color Precision Mist (#8B9BB8). Text: 'A boutique business hotel designed with the precision of the future and the warmth of true hospitality.' Max-width 520px. Margin-top 24px from headline.

CTA ROW: Two buttons, left-aligned, flex row, gap 16px, margin-top 40px. Primary CTA 'Explore Rooms': solid Neural Violet (#7C3AED) background, Coldframe White label in IBM Plex Sans SemiBold 15px, padding 14px 32px, no border-radius (sharp rectangular corners to reinforce technical precision). Secondary CTA 'View Current Offers': transparent background, 1.5px solid Signal Graphite (#2E3A50) border, Coldframe White label, same padding — on hover, border transitions to Synapse Cyan with a faint Synapse Cyan glow (box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0,212,232,0.35)).

VERTICAL RHYTHM: 160px padding-top, 140px padding-bottom. The text stack (eyebrow + headline + subheadline + CTAs) is vertically centered in the viewport, anchored slightly above true center (top offset ~45%) to give the node-graph field breathing room below.

DECORATIVE DETAIL: A single 1px horizontal Signal Graphite line runs the full width of the section at the very bottom, with a 6px-diameter Synapse Cyan filled circle centered on it — this is the narrative transition device that appears between all sections on the page.

RESPONSIVE: Mobile — headline scales to 48px, text block goes full width (columns 1–12) with 24px horizontal padding, node-graph pattern remains full-bleed at 35% opacity overlay so text is legible, CTAs stack vertically with 12px gap.

SECTION TYPE: Feature Grid. INTENT: Decode the three core pillars of the Axiom experience — Intelligent Workspaces, Curated Calm, Frictionless Service — in a technically precise, scannable grid that reads as a system spec sheet rather than a generic card layout.

SURFACE: Full-width section on Circuit Slate (#1E2535) background. This mid-depth surface creates a clear visual layer shift from the Axiom Void hero above. Vertical padding: 88px top, 88px bottom.

EYEBROW: IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 12px, letter-spacing 0.16em, color Synapse Cyan (#00D4E8). Text: 'THE AXIOM DIFFERENCE'. Left-aligned to the grid's left edge (column 1). Short 24px Synapse Cyan underline rule beneath, matching the hero eyebrow treatment for cross-section consistency.

HEADLINE: Archivo Bold, 44px, tracking −0.01em, line-height 1.15, color Coldframe White (#EDF1F7). Text: 'Built for the Way You Work and Rest'. Left-aligned. Max-width 600px. Margin-top 12px from eyebrow, margin-bottom 56px from the card grid — this generous gap separates the section header from the cards, creating a masthead-style header moment before the grid begins.

CARD GRID: Three equal-width columns (columns 1–4, 5–8, 9–12 on a 12-col grid), 32px column gap. Each card is a floating panel: Circuit Slate base with a 1.5px Signal Graphite (#2E3A50) border on all sides, and a top-edge 2px Synapse Cyan (#00D4E8) accent line (full card width) that functions as a 'live' indicator — a technical diagram motif. Card background: slightly lighter than Circuit Slate, using a subtle 4% Coldframe White tint (approximately #222A3A) to lift the card surface off the section background. Card padding: 36px on all sides. No border-radius — sharp corners throughout.

CARD INTERNAL ANATOMY (each card, top to bottom):
1. TECHNICAL ICON / DIAGRAM: A small abstract technical glyph (16×16px bounding box) in Synapse Cyan — for card 1 a node-cluster symbol, for card 2 a waveform/sine line, for card 3 a branching flow-path. Positioned top-left of card content area. Below it, a 1px Signal Graphite horizontal rule spanning the full card interior width, with 16px margin below the icon and 16px above the title — this rule functions as a technical annotation separator.
2. CARD TITLE: Archivo Bold, 26px, tracking 0, line-height 1.2, color Coldframe White (#EDF1F7). Left-aligned.
3. CARD DESCRIPTION: IBM Plex Sans, 16px, weight 400, line-height 1.65, color Precision Mist (#8B9BB8). Left-aligned. Margin-top 12px from title.
4. CARD METADATA TAG (bottom of card, pushed to bottom via flex column + margin-top auto): IBM Plex Mono uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.14em, color Synapse Cyan (#00D4E8). For card 1: 'WORKSPACE INTEL'. For card 2: 'DESIGN SYSTEM'. For card 3: 'SERVICE PROTOCOL'. This tag functions as a system classification label — a spec-sheet annotation.

HOVER STATE: On card hover, the top-edge Synapse Cyan line brightens (opacity 1 → full saturation), and a faint Synapse Cyan glow appears on the card border (box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(0,212,232,0.2)). The card title shifts from Coldframe White to Synapse Cyan. Transition: 200ms ease.

SECTION BOTTOM: The same Signal Graphite horizontal rule with centered Synapse Cyan node-dot transition device appears at the section's bottom edge, consistent with the hero section's closing rule.

RESPONSIVE: Tablet — 2 columns (first two cards side by side, third card full-width below). Mobile — single column stack, each card full-width, 24px vertical gap between cards.

SECTION TYPE: CTA. INTENT: Convert engaged visitors into bookers or inquiry leads. This is the page's most chromatic, high-energy moment — a saturated Neural Violet full-bleed panel that breaks the dark-surface alternation and signals urgency.

SURFACE: Full-width section with Neural Violet (#7C3AED) as the solid full-bleed background. This is the only section on the page with a saturated color background — it is intentional and unmissable. A subtle abstract neural node-graph pattern (matching the hero's node-graph motif but at very low opacity — ~8% Coldframe White lines) overlays the Neural Violet background, creating depth and reinforcing the AI Lab visual language without competing with the text. Vertical padding: 104px top, 104px bottom.

COMPOSITION: Centred layout. All content is centred horizontally within the viewport. This is one of the few centred compositions on the page — justified by the CTA section's role as a terminal, high-intention moment where symmetry conveys resolve and finality, consistent with the layout_family's 'impact block' structure cue.

EYEBROW: IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 12px, letter-spacing 0.16em, color Pulse Amethyst (#C084FC). Text: 'READY TO EXPERIENCE AXIOM?'. Centred. A 32px-wide, 2px-tall Pulse Amethyst underline rule centred beneath the eyebrow text — slightly wider than the hero and feature grid eyebrow rules to signal escalation.

HEADLINE: Archivo Black, 56px, tracking −0.02em, line-height 1.08, color Coldframe White (#EDF1F7). Text: 'Your Next Stay Starts Here'. Centred. Margin-top 16px from eyebrow. This headline is intentionally shorter and punchier than the hero headline — it reads as a command, not a description.

SUBHEADLINE: IBM Plex Sans, 18px, weight 400, line-height 1.6, color Coldframe White at 85% opacity (rgba(237,241,247,0.85)). Text: 'Explore tailored packages, premium rooms, and exclusive offers crafted for business travelers.' Centred. Max-width 540px, centred in viewport. Margin-top 20px from headline.

CTA ROW: Two buttons, centred flex row, gap 20px, margin-top 44px. Primary CTA 'Book Your Stay': Coldframe White (#EDF1F7) background, Axiom Void (#0A0C14) label text in IBM Plex Sans SemiBold 15px, padding 16px 40px, sharp rectangular corners. On hover, background transitions to Pulse Amethyst (#C084FC) with Axiom Void text — a luminous inversion that uses the palette expressively. Secondary CTA 'See Our Offers': transparent background, 1.5px solid Coldframe White border, Coldframe White label, same padding. On hover, border and label transition to Pulse Amethyst.

DECORATIVE DETAIL: Two thin horizontal Signal Graphite (#2E3A50) lines — one at 20% opacity — run the full section width at the top and bottom edges of the section, each with a small Pulse Amethyst node-dot at center. This maintains the page's recurring circuit-rule transition device while adapting it to the violet surface context.

RESPONSIVE: Mobile — headline scales to 40px, subheadline max-width becomes 100% with 24px horizontal padding, CTA buttons stack vertically (full-width on mobile, 280px max-width each) with 14px gap.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
## Accommodations Page — Axiom Hotel

### Page Identity & Signature Moment
The signature moment of this page lives in Section 2 (item_grid): a full-bleed Neural Violet (#7C3AED) to Pulse Amethyst (#C084FC) gradient panel that acts as the structural backbone of the room-card grid. Each room card floats as a "floating panel" — a direct AI Lab visual cue — with Circuit Slate (#1E2535) surfaces, Signal Graphite (#2E3A50) borders, and Synapse Cyan (#00D4E8) hover glows. The room titles are set in IBM Plex Mono uppercase as oversized monospace labels, treating the room names as system identifiers rather than marketing copy. This is unmistakably AI Lab: technical, precise, and future-facing — not a standard hotel card grid, but a configuration selection interface.

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
**Section 1 (page_header):** Dense, full-bleed Axiom Void (#0A0C14) masthead with a dramatically oversized H1 headline that bleeds asymmetrically off the left grid column, anchored by a thin Synapse Cyan horizontal rule below the eyebrow. Sparse — maximum negative space above and below the type stack. No imagery. Type is the hero.

**Section 2 (item_grid):** The signature moment. A Neural Violet → Pulse Amethyst full-bleed gradient background occupies the entire section. Four room cards are arranged in a 2×2 grid on desktop, each card a Circuit Slate floating panel with Signal Graphite borders and Synapse Cyan accent glows on hover. Dense information architecture: room title in IBM Plex Mono, description in IBM Plex Sans, and metadata rendered as a monospace spec table below the description. A single CTA button anchors below the grid.

**Section 3 (feature_grid):** Returns to Circuit Slate (#1E2535) background — a mid-depth surface that creates visual breathing room after the high-energy violet section. Three amenity items are laid out as a horizontal index strip with left-aligned IBM Plex Mono eyebrow labels, large Archivo H3 titles, and IBM Plex Sans body. The layout shifts to a side-tabbed / index-list structure — NOT three identical cards — with a vertical Signal Graphite rule dividing a left label column from a right description column. Sparse rhythm with generous padding.

### Color & Surface Logic
- Section 1: Axiom Void background, Coldframe White headline, Synapse Cyan rule and eyebrow
- Section 2: Neural Violet → Pulse Amethyst gradient background, Circuit Slate cards, Coldframe White body text, Synapse Cyan metadata and hover glows
- Section 3: Circuit Slate background, Coldframe White headlines, Precision Mist body text, Signal Graphite vertical divider rule, Synapse Cyan eyebrow underline
- The palette rotates: void → vivid violet → mid-depth slate — never repeating the same surface twice consecutively.

### Typography Hierarchy
- H1 (Section 1): Archivo Black, 72–80px, tight tracking (−0.03em), Coldframe White, left-aligned, bleeds past the standard grid margin on the right
- H2 (Section 2): Archivo Bold, 44px, tracking −0.01em, Coldframe White, left-aligned within the section header above the grid
- H3 (Section 3): Archivo SemiBold, 28–32px, Coldframe White
- Room titles (Section 2 cards): IBM Plex Mono uppercase, 13px, wide tracking (0.14em), Synapse Cyan
- Eyebrow labels: IBM Plex Mono uppercase, 11px, tracking 0.16em, Synapse Cyan
- Body: IBM Plex Sans, 16–17px, 1.65 line-height, Coldframe White on dark/violet surfaces, Precision Mist for metadata
- Metadata specs: IBM Plex Mono, 11px, Precision Mist, rendered as key: value pairs

### Density & Whitespace Logic
Section 1 is deliberately sparse — 120px top padding, 80px bottom — letting the type breathe like a terminal prompt in an empty interface. Section 2 is the densest section: the card grid is tight with 24px gutters, and the metadata tables compress information to signal technical depth. Section 3 returns to measured spacing (80px vertical padding) with wide horizontal margins, using whitespace as a structural element in the index-strip layout.

### Responsive Behavior
- Section 1: Single column, headline wraps to 2–3 lines at mobile, eyebrow and rule remain left-aligned
- Section 2: 2×2 grid collapses to single-column card stack on mobile; gradient panel maintains full bleed; CTA stays centered below stack
- Section 3: Index-strip collapses to stacked list on mobile; vertical divider rule becomes a horizontal rule between items; left label column stacks above description column

### Fit Within Shared Design System
This page uses the full design system palette without introducing new colors. Archivo and IBM Plex Mono dominate the expressive moments; IBM Plex Sans handles all body copy. The node-graph and floating-panel visual cues from the AI Lab aesthetic are expressed through the card architecture in Section 2. The storytelling scroll structure is honored through the deliberate surface alternation (void → violet → slate) and the progressive density rhythm (sparse → dense → measured).

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
**Section 1 — Page Header (Masthead Style)**

Background: Full-bleed Axiom Void (#0A0C14). No imagery, no illustration. Type is the entire composition.

**Layout:** Single-column, left-aligned. The section occupies 100vw. Top padding: 120px. Bottom padding: 80px. Left margin: aligned to the standard 12-column grid's column 1 start (approx. 80px on desktop), but the H1 headline is allowed to extend past the right grid boundary — it runs to approximately 105% of the grid width, creating deliberate off-grid tension that signals precision engineering rather than polished marketing.

**Eyebrow:** IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.16em, color Synapse Cyan (#00D4E8). Text: 'ACCOMMODATIONS'. Positioned at the top of the type stack. Below the eyebrow text, a thin horizontal rule — 1px, Synapse Cyan, 48px wide — sits flush left, 6px below the eyebrow text. This rule is a structural device, not decoration: it anchors the eyebrow to the grid and introduces the AI Lab's technical diagram language.

**Headline (H1):** Archivo Black, 72px on desktop (scales to 48px on tablet, 36px on mobile). Tracking: −0.03em. Color: Coldframe White (#EDF1F7). Text: 'Rooms Designed Like Systems. Felt Like Home.' Two-line break preferred: 'Rooms Designed Like Systems.' on line 1, 'Felt Like Home.' on line 2. The second line 'Felt Like Home.' is rendered at the same scale but in a Neural Violet (#7C3AED) to Pulse Amethyst (#C084FC) horizontal gradient fill — this creates a dramatic weight contrast between the cold-precision first line (white) and the warmer, luminous second line (violet gradient), mirroring the hotel's dual identity. Margin-top from eyebrow rule: 24px.

**Subheadline:** IBM Plex Sans, 18px, weight 400, line-height 1.65, color Precision Mist (#8B9BB8). Text: 'Each space at Axiom is calibrated for focus, rest, and everything in between.' Max-width: 520px. Left-aligned. Margin-top from H1: 28px.

**No CTAs, no images.** The section ends with 80px of bottom padding before the next section begins. The sparse negative space is intentional — it functions like a terminal cursor blinking in an empty prompt, preparing the visitor for the dense room grid below.

**Responsive:** On mobile, headline wraps naturally to 3 lines; the off-grid bleed is removed and the headline stays within the mobile margin. Eyebrow and rule remain left-aligned at all breakpoints.

**Section 2 — Item Grid (Signature Moment: Floating Panel Configuration Interface)**

This is the page's signature moment. Background: full-bleed Neural Violet (#7C3AED) to Pulse Amethyst (#C084FC) diagonal gradient (135deg), running edge-to-edge with no margin or border-radius. The vivid violet panel is a deliberate rupture in the dark palette — it signals that the visitor has entered the 'selection interface' of the hotel, evoking an AI system's configuration screen.

Top padding: 96px. Bottom padding: 96px.

**Section Header (above the grid):**
- Eyebrow: IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 11px, tracking 0.16em, color Coldframe White (#EDF1F7) at 70% opacity (slightly muted against the violet to avoid competing with the cards). Text: 'OUR ROOM CATEGORIES'. No underline rule here — the violet background itself provides enough visual grounding.
- Headline (H2): Archivo Bold, 44px, tracking −0.01em, color Coldframe White (#EDF1F7). Text: 'Find Your Optimal Configuration'. Left-aligned. Max-width: 640px. Margin-top from eyebrow: 12px. Margin-bottom from grid: 48px.

**Card Grid:** 2×2 grid on desktop (2 columns, 2 rows), 24px column gutter, 24px row gutter. On tablet: 2×2 maintained if viewport allows, else 1-column stack. On mobile: single-column stack.

Each card is a 'floating panel' — Circuit Slate (#1E2535) background, 1px Signal Graphite (#2E3A50) border, 16px border-radius, 32px internal padding (top/bottom) and 28px (left/right). Cards have a subtle drop shadow (0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)) to emphasize the floating-above-surface quality. On hover: a Synapse Cyan (#00D4E8) 1px border replaces the Signal Graphite border, and a soft Synapse Cyan glow (box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(0,212,232,0.2)) emanates from the card edge.

**Card Anatomy (top to bottom):**
1. Room title: IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 13px, tracking 0.14em, color Synapse Cyan (#00D4E8). Treated as a system identifier (e.g., 'SIGNAL ROOM', 'LOGIC SUITE'). This is the most visually distinctive typographic move on the cards — monospace cyan labels evoke terminal output.
2. A 1px Signal Graphite horizontal divider, 100% card width, 12px below the title.
3. Description: IBM Plex Sans, 16px, weight 400, line-height 1.65, color Coldframe White (#EDF1F7). Margin-top: 14px. Max 3–4 lines.
4. Metadata block: IBM Plex Mono, 11px, tracking 0.10em, color Precision Mist (#8B9BB8). Rendered as a two-column key:value table within the card — left column is the key (e.g., 'SIZE', 'OCCUPANCY', 'CONNECTIVITY') in uppercase, right column is the value. 6px row gap. Margin-top: 20px from description. This metadata table is the technical diagram element of the AI Lab aesthetic applied to hospitality data.

**Four cards, one per room category:**
- Card 1: Signal Room (28 sqm / 1 guest / 10 Gbps fiber)
- Card 2: Logic Suite (48 sqm / 1–2 guests / 10 Gbps fiber)
- Card 3: Executive Node (62 sqm / 1–2 guests / 10 Gbps fiber + VPN hardware)
- Card 4: Apex Penthouse (120 sqm / up to 4 guests / Dedicated private network)

**CTA:** Below the grid, centered, margin-top 48px. Single button: 'Inquire About Availability'. Button style: Coldframe White (#EDF1F7) background, Axiom Void (#0A0C14) text, IBM Plex Sans SemiBold 15px, 14px vertical padding, 32px horizontal padding, 6px border-radius. On hover: Neural Violet (#7C3AED) background, Coldframe White text. This inverted button (light on violet background) ensures the CTA reads clearly without competing with the Neural Violet section surface.

**Decorative element:** A faint abstract node-graph pattern (dots connected by thin lines) is rendered at 4% opacity in Coldframe White, positioned in the top-right quadrant of the section background — behind all cards. This reinforces the AI Lab neural-pattern visual cue at full amplitude without obscuring content.

**Section 3 — Feature Grid (Side-Tabbed Index Strip)**

Background: Circuit Slate (#1E2535). This mid-depth surface creates visual decompression after the high-energy violet section, while maintaining the dark palette continuity. Top padding: 96px. Bottom padding: 96px.

**Section Header:**
- Eyebrow: IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 11px, tracking 0.16em, color Synapse Cyan (#00D4E8). Text: 'STANDARD ACROSS ALL ROOMS'. A 1px Synapse Cyan underline rule, 36px wide, sits 6px below the eyebrow text, flush left — the same structural rule device introduced in Section 1, creating cross-section visual consistency.
- Headline (H2): Archivo Bold, 44px, tracking −0.01em, color Coldframe White (#EDF1F7). Text: 'Every Room Comes Fully Loaded'. Left-aligned. Max-width: 600px. Margin-top from eyebrow rule: 20px. Margin-bottom: 56px.

**Layout — Index Strip (NOT a three-card grid):** The three amenity items are laid out as a vertical index list on desktop, using a two-column asymmetric split within the 12-column grid. Left column: 3 grid columns wide. Right column: 7 grid columns wide. A 1px Signal Graphite (#2E3A50) vertical rule separates the two columns, running the full height of all three items combined. This vertical rule is the structural spine of the section — it evokes a circuit-board trace or a technical diagram axis.

**Left column (label column):** For each item, the IBM Plex Mono uppercase label is placed here — 11px, tracking 0.14em, Precision Mist (#8B9BB8). Labels: 'CONNECTIVITY', 'CLIMATE', 'ACOUSTICS'. Each label is vertically centered to its corresponding right-column content block. The left column communicates system-category tagging, like metadata annotations on a technical diagram.

**Right column (content column):** For each item:
1. Item title: Archivo SemiBold, 28px, color Coldframe White (#EDF1F7), tracking −0.01em.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Axiom Journal page is a precision-engineered editorial space that reads like a technical dispatch — not a blog, not a magazine, but a curated intelligence feed from a forward-thinking institution. The page unfolds across three distinct section skeletons, each with a different density register, ensuring no two consecutive blocks feel structurally identical.

**Section Sequence & Rhythm:**
Section 1 (page_header) is a high-voltage, full-bleed masthead moment — sparse, typographically dominant, with the headline functioning as a near-full-viewport typographic event. Section 2 (article_list) is the page's densest block — an asymmetric index layout with left-anchored metadata columns and right-anchored article content, evoking a technical log or research index. Section 3 (CTA) is a compressed, high-contrast close — a Neural Violet full-bleed panel that snaps the editorial journey back into the commercial product with controlled urgency.

**Signature Moment:**
The page's signature moment lives in Section 1: the headline "Dispatches from the Edge of How We Work" is set in Archivo Black at display scale (72–80px on desktop), left-aligned, with the word "Edge" rendered in a Neural Violet-to-Pulse Amethyst gradient and broken onto its own typographic line — creating a deliberate weight-contrast stunt where one word dominates the visual field. Behind the headline, a faint abstract neural-node graph pattern (thin Synapse Cyan strokes on Axiom Void, ~8% opacity) spans the full width of the section, referencing the AI Lab aesthetic's node-graph visual cue without competing with the type. This is not decorative — it is structural, anchoring the editorial identity of the journal in the brand's technical visual language. The pattern extends slightly below the section boundary, bleeding into the top edge of Section 2 to create a narrative transition.

**Color & Surface Usage:**
- Section 1: Axiom Void (#0A0C14) full-bleed background. Type in Coldframe White and Neural Violet/Pulse Amethyst gradient. Eyebrow in Synapse Cyan (IBM Plex Mono, uppercase). Neural node pattern in Synapse Cyan at low opacity.
- Section 2: Circuit Slate (#1E2535) background, creating a mid-depth surface shift. Article cards/rows sit on Signal Graphite (#2E3A50) bordered containers. Category chips in Synapse Cyan (IBM Plex Mono). Article titles in Coldframe White. Metadata in Precision Mist. Thin Signal Graphite horizontal rules divide article rows.
- Section 3: Neural Violet (#7C3AED) full-bleed background — a saturated color break that signals the end of the editorial zone and the return to the product. Type in Coldframe White. Secondary CTA outlined in Coldframe White at 60% opacity.

**Typographic Hierarchy:**
- H1 (Section 1 headline): Archivo Black, 72–80px, −0.03em tracking, left-aligned, multi-line with "Edge" on its own line in gradient treatment.
- Eyebrow labels: IBM Plex Mono, 11–12px, 0.16em letter-spacing, uppercase, Synapse Cyan.
- Section 2 headline ("What We're Thinking About"): Archivo Bold, 40px, −0.01em tracking, Coldframe White, left-aligned.
- Article titles: Archivo Semibold, 22–24px, Coldframe White.
- Article descriptions: IBM Plex Sans, 16px, 1.65 line-height, Precision Mist.
- Section 3 headline: Archivo Bold, 48px, Coldframe White, centered.
- CTA buttons: IBM Plex Sans Medium, 15px, uppercase, 0.08em tracking.

**Density / Whitespace Logic:**
Section 1 is intentionally sparse — generous vertical padding (120px top, 100px bottom) lets the oversized type breathe as a visual event. Section 2 is the page's information-dense core — tighter row spacing (40px between article rows), compact metadata columns, and horizontal rules create a log/index feel. Section 3 is compressed (80px vertical padding) — a tight, punchy close that doesn't linger.

**Responsive Behavior:**
- Mobile: Section 1 headline scales to 40–48px, single column. Neural node pattern remains but scales to viewport width. Section 2 collapses the asymmetric index to a stacked single-column card list with category chip above title. Section 3 stacks CTAs vertically, centered.
- Tablet: Section 1 headline at 56–64px. Section 2 uses a 5-col grid (2 metadata / 3 content). Section 3 CTAs side by side.

**Fit Within Shared Design System:**
This page uses all eight palette colors in purposeful roles. The IBM Plex Mono accent font appears on every eyebrow and category chip. Archivo carries all headline moments. The node-graph visual cue from the AI Lab aesthetic is deployed as a structural background element, not a corner decoration. The storytelling scroll layout family is honored through clear sequential narrative: editorial identity → editorial content → editorial-to-product bridge.
